about: Manual review of ACCEPTED drafts (passed every code gate), done before the solver gate ran, so the solver can be scored against it. good = usable as is. v1: random 20 (seed 7). v2: random 12 of the 60 accepted at difficulty 4-5 (seed 3).

with_statement-51.note: correct option is the longest (1.3x the next): mild cue, under the 1.5x line

function_calls-52.problem: semantic duplicate of bank function_calls-03 (what is the value in the parentheses called)

integers-52.problem: accepts only 'casting'; the course says type conversion, so a student using the course's term is marked wrong; also tagged integers instead of type_conversion

string_methods-53.problem: function name extract_username already used by bank regular_expressions-05 (now caught by the name gate)

boolean_expressions-51.problem: gotcha: x != y == False is a chained comparison, not taught in the course

floats-53.problem: tests rely on round() rounding halves to even (round(4.5) == 4) while the stem says 'nearest integer'

pytest_testing-51.problem: WRONG KEY: with cube = x ** 2, pytest stops at the first failing assert, cube(2) == 8, not cube(3) == 27

generators-51.note: stem says 'and why' but the options carry no reasons
